AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.get_goal.short: Returns the current goal as an untyped term

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.unify_go.short: Unifies the current goal with a given term, filling holes on either side

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.constr_f.short: Builds a term of a given type by running a tactic, and returns that term

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.eunify.short: Elaborates an untyped term by unifying it with a given term, and returns the result

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.echange_.short: Restates the goal as a pattern whose holes are filled by unification with the goal

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.echange.short: Like change, but the new statement may contain holes, filled from the current goal

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.get_inst.short: Returns the instance that typeclass resolution finds for a given class

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.sapply_1.short: The tactic behind sapply_1: applies a lemma with one premise left as a new goal

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.sapply_2.short: The tactic behind sapply_2: applies a lemma with two premises left as new goals

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.sapply_3.short: The tactic behind sapply_3: applies a lemma with three premises left as new goals

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.sapply_1.short: Applies a lemma to the goal through exactly one premise, leaving it as the new goal

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.sapply_2.short: Applies a lemma to the goal through exactly two premises, leaving them as new goals

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.sapply_3.short: Applies a lemma to the goal through exactly three premises, leaving them as new goals

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.normaliz.short: Proves the goal with a tactic, then closes it with the fully reduced proof term

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.learn.short: Adds a fact to the context unless a hypothesis of the same statement is already there

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.real_pro.short: Runs a tactic and fails unless the goal changed syntactically, universe instances aside

d: Ltac eval_under_binder tac binder T body

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.eval_und.short: Runs a term-computing tactic on the body of a binder and abstracts the result over that binder

d: Ltac eval_under_let tac binder T defn body

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.eval_und.short: Runs a tactic on a term under a local definition, and rebuilds the definition around the result

d: Ltac eval_under_binder2 tac binder1 T1 binder2 T2 body

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.eval_und.short: Runs a tactic on a term under two binders, and rebinds the result under the original names

d: Ltac eval_under_binder_pair tac binder T body

AffineConstructive.tactics.misc.eval_und.short: Like eval_under_binder, but the tactic also returns a result independent of the bound variable
